title: The Bell of the Undercroft
author: Odile Quintana
blurb: Gideon Blackwood, a pest controller called to something with fingerprints, doesn't believe, has never believed, will not begin believing now. Then the sleep recordings capture a second voice answering questions — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now she must learn the song's last verse without singing along, and time is already running out.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
